tool.name: unreal
tool.title: Unreal Editor
tool.description: Discover and execute Unreal Editor workflows through UE Python/reflection, console commands, ordered batches, transactions, and asynchronous task tracking.

capabilities.title: Actors and worlds
capabilities.summary: Find, spawn, select, transform, attach, inspect, and delete actors; load and save levels.

capabilities.title: Assets and Content Browser
capabilities.summary: Query, create, import, duplicate, rename, save, export, and delete assets and folders.

capabilities.title: Blueprints and reflection
capabilities.summary: Create and inspect Blueprint assets, classes, variables and components; compile and validate them.

capabilities.title: AI and navigation
capabilities.summary: Inspect AI systems, behavior assets, controllers, perception, and navigation data.

capabilities.title: Animation and Control Rig
capabilities.summary: Inspect and edit animations, rigs, keys, bindings, sections, and Sequencer data.

capabilities.title: Automation tests
capabilities.summary: Discover, run, stop, and inspect Unreal Automation tests and results.

capabilities.title: Project and editor settings
capabilities.summary: Inspect, update, reset, and persist configuration and reflected settings.

capabilities.title: Conversation graphs
capabilities.summary: Create and edit conversation assets, nodes, links, participants, and entry points.

capabilities.title: Data Registry
capabilities.summary: List registries, sources, schemas, runtime sources, and resolved items.

capabilities.title: Dataflow graphs
capabilities.summary: Create and modify Dataflow graphs, nodes, pins, comments, and variables.

capabilities.title: Editor state and capture
capabilities.summary: Inspect selections, open assets, viewport state, camera state, and capture images.

capabilities.title: Logs and console variables
capabilities.summary: Inspect logs, categories, verbosity, console variables, and console commands.

capabilities.title: Game Features
capabilities.summary: Discover Game Feature plugins and request activation or deactivation.

capabilities.title: Gameplay Tags
capabilities.summary: Inspect, add, remove, rename, and find references to Gameplay Tags.

capabilities.title: Gameplay Ability System
capabilities.summary: Inspect abilities, attribute sets, active effects, tags, and Gameplay Cues.

capabilities.title: UE-side MCP clients
capabilities.summary: Inspect UE-side MCP client configurations and toolsets when enabled.

capabilities.title: Niagara
capabilities.summary: Create and inspect systems, emitters, scripts, renderers, modules, and parameters.

capabilities.title: Procedural Content Generation
capabilities.summary: Create and edit PCG graphs and nodes, run generation, and perform spatial queries.

capabilities.title: Physics assets
capabilities.summary: Create and edit bodies, shapes, mass properties, constraints, and limits.

capabilities.title: Plugin management
capabilities.summary: Discover plugins, inspect dependencies, create project plugins, and update descriptors.

capabilities.title: Semantic search
capabilities.summary: Index and search project assets or source descriptions semantically when available.

capabilities.title: Slate inspection and interaction
capabilities.summary: Inspect widget trees and automate clicks, typing, dragging, forms, and screenshots.

capabilities.title: StateTree
capabilities.summary: Inspect and edit StateTree tasks, evaluators, transitions, conditions, and bindings.

capabilities.title: UMG and MVVM
capabilities.summary: Create Widget Blueprints and edit widget trees, slots, variables, events, and bindings.

capabilities.title: World Conditions
capabilities.summary: Inspect and evaluate World Condition schemas, contexts, and query definitions.

capabilities.title: UnLua and project APIs
capabilities.summary: Inspect UnLua classes, execute project Python helpers, and interact with project-specific reflected APIs.
